research_task.title: Replay a materially delivered orbit interface

summary: A fresh-attempt inventory independently reproduced the linked parent's delivery obstruction: no exact orbit-interface source or pinned offline Lean and Mathlib closure was present, so no build or axiom audit was possible.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the one directly linked parent, this run independently reproduces the same missing-delivery obstruction with a fresh digest-identified inventory and independent boundary, alternate-stream, embedded-payload-indicator, and application-resolution checks; it changes or contradicts no mathematical, compiler, or axiom result.
value_assessment.evidence: Two hidden-inclusive inventories agreed on only the supplied research brief and three later reviewer-authored records with no directory; direct filesystem enumeration, root classification, stream inspection, bounded content indicators, and application resolution independently supported the obstruction.
value_assessment.falsifier: Discovery of an ordinary supplier-delivered entry already present at the inventory boundary containing the exact declarations and pinned offline closure would overturn this scoped absence result.

claims.statement: At the recorded fresh-attempt inventory boundary, no exact supplier-authored orbit-interface source or pinned offline Lean and Mathlib project was materially present, so the required clean builds and axiom reports could not begin.
claims.evidence_summary: Two hidden-inclusive inventories agreed on four ordinary root files and no directories; only the research brief predates the three reviewer-authored records. Independent enumeration and boundary checks found no concealed ordinary delivery route.
claims.verification_method: Repeat hidden-inclusive top-level and recursive enumeration, classify timestamps and roles, verify the supplied brief's digest, inspect the root link state and brief streams, and repeat the listed bounded content checks.

limitations: The claim is limited to the permitted directory and the recorded inventory time.
No source was elaborated, no build was run, and no axiom report was produced.
The content checks cover only the listed ordinary embedding forms and are not general steganographic analysis.
The result makes no mathematical claim about the Riemann Hypothesis or zeros of the zeta function.
failed_approaches: The prescribed offline replay could not start because the exact source, revision pins, and dependency closure were absent.
The first combined adversarial audit command had a PowerShell pipeline syntax error; the corrected read-only command completed successfully.
next_actions: Supply the exact three-declaration source and a fully materialized pinned offline Lean and Mathlib project in a fresh attempt, then perform the ordered two-replay audit.
